text.en: Pet parents warmly commend Julia and Melanie for their attentive styling advice, individualized care, and keen eye for skin allergies. Regular clients note that the groomers form close bonds with dogs across multiple visits. Whilst one puppy owner felt instructions were disregarded, the overwhelming consensus highlights skilled and conscientious care.

Clients frequently remark on the soothing, low-stress environment provided for dogs of all sizes and coats, from pugs to malamutes. Reviewers note that anxious animals arrive happily and remain relaxed during baths and clipping. One customer reported a nick requiring veterinary attention, but other owners praise the tender and reassuring touch.

Owners regularly praise the quality of finished grooms, noting exceptionally soft coats, precise scissor work, and neat nail trimming for dogs and cats. Many reviewers mention receiving compliments on their pets' appearance following styling visits. Although one client was dissatisfied with an unrequested close trim, most report immaculate grooming results.

q.en: Does The Den Paw Spa groom cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm bringing cats into the salon for routine claw trims and hygiene maintenance.

q.en: How long do standard grooming sessions usually take?

a.en: Pet owners mention that grooms are typically completed within two hours, minimising time spent away from home.

q.en: How are appointments scheduled at the salon?

a.en: Clients highlight that appointments are arranged through an easy-to-use online booking portal.

q.en: Can the groomers accommodate pets with skin allergies?

a.en: Reviewers report that the team carefully notes allergies and monitors coats for early signs of skin irritation.
